description: Cross-platform GPU-native terminal multiplexer for agentic CLI workflows. Runs Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode side by side in branch-aware workspaces on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
rules: Paneflow is a GPU-native terminal multiplexer rendered via GPUI (Zed's Rust UI framework). It is NOT a TUI and NOT an Electron app.

Configuration lives in paneflow.json: ~/.config/paneflow/ on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/paneflow/ on macOS, and %APPDATA%\paneflow\ on Windows. Config keys are English and must never be translated or renamed.
Keybinding strings use Ctrl/Alt/Shift modifier names verbatim (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+D).

Paneflow is free and open source under GPL-3.0. There is no paid tier, no login, and no hosted backend. Desktop telemetry is disabled unless the user explicitly opts in, never includes terminal contents/prompts/paths, and PANEFLOW_NO_TELEMETRY=1 disables it unconditionally.
Paneflow ships native builds for Linux, macOS Apple Silicon, and Windows x64. Windows ARM64 and macOS Intel are not shipped today.
The live documentation is at https://paneflow.dev/docs. Raw Markdown twins of every docs page are served at the page URL plus .md (e.g. https://paneflow.dev/docs/installation/linux.md).
